g.text: Solid points are medians of twelve individual durations; faint markers show two six-trial graph medians. Repetitions reuse each graph.
Two graph seeds × one fixed scalar sampling seed. All cases, controls, losses and ranges remain; ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
Lines connect tested endpoints without threshold interpolation. All 0 flagged calls retained. No control normalization or historical pooling.
